label: Dahua IPC-HDBW5442E-ZE
description: Dahua IPC-HDBW5442E-ZE is a 4 MP WizMind dome with a motorised vari-focal lens, starlight low-light imaging, face-attribute capture and perimeter protection in an IP67/IK10 metal housing. It has one RJ45 10/100Base-T port taking PoE 802.3af (Class 0) or 12 VDC / 24 VAC, plus RS-485 and 1/1 alarm and audio terminals, and there is no Wi-Fi radio on this SKU.
notes: From the Dahua datasheet: Ethernet 'RJ-45 (10/100 Base-T)'; Power Supply 'DC 12V (+-30%), AC 24V (+-30%), PoE (802.3af) (Class 0)'; Power Consumption '<12.4W' (max stream + IR + focus); RS-485 N/A on this model, alarm 1/1 channel in/out, audio 1/1; IP67, IK10; ONVIF Profile S/G/T plus CGI; microSD/NAS/FTP edge storage. Class 0 is the 802.3af default class (0.44-12.95 W), which matches the sub-13 W ceiling, so poeIn is set to the 12.95 W Type 1 allocation and not to a 25.5 W Type 2 figure. Not confirmed: Dahua gives no separate idle draw, and this is the pre-S3 datasheet revision - the S3 build is listed as discontinued on Dahua's site, so treat current-stock part numbers as a variant of the same chassis. The sibling already in the catalogue is the 4 MP eyeball IPC-HDW5442TM-AS; this is the dome with motorised zoom, a genuinely different enclosure and lens.
